reason: A more directly targets the heat-transfer bottleneck through increased bonded interfacial area and offers a controlled, falsifiable comparison while leaving the load-bearing HEA composition unchanged. Its claimed 2–3× conductivity gain and phonon-coupling rationale are overextended from GaN/diamond and should instead be framed as reduced effective interfacial resistance, but B is less physically credible because Cu is likely to segregate or soften this refractory BCC alloy and metallic heat transport is not plausibly improved primarily through the proposed phonon mechanism.
